content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 8(d) is a material IP deviation — it grants TrueLink a worldwide right to "distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit" Credit Data, i.e. independent exploitation of our borrower data rather than processing to deliver the services (walk-away territory). The Agreement also gives us no ownership of or licence to the results of the Support Services we pay for; Section 10 only makes them confidential.

**Redline (fallback target, two surgical ops):**
1. Section 8(d) narrowed to "process Credit Data solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services to Client," preserving the retained Non-Competition Agreement limitation verbatim.
2. New sentence after Section 4 granting Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense all results of the Support Services for its business.

TrueLink's retained ownership of the Interface (Section 2(d)) satisfies the vendor tools/know-how element and was left untouched.
